scanNote:
14-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (99-bet) - O'QISh MATNI va LUG'AT.

Yuqorida o'ngda TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '14', chapida 'Live and Let Live'.

CHAP TOMON (yashil fon), ko'k sarlavha 'Animals in Danger': 'The World Wildlife Fund needs people to ACT now to help save the ten most endangered species in the world.'
1-ODAM: 'John Hewett, aged 26, is planning to 'ADOPT' a rhino through a special rhino PROTECTION PROJECT.' (yosh erkak surati) Pufak: 'I found out about the dangers rhinos face through a NATURE DOCUMENTARY on TV. Rhinos live in eastern and southern Africa. They weigh from three to five tonnes and can reach a SPEED of around 45 kilometres per hour. Although it is ILLEGAL, hunters kill them for their horns, which are very VALUABLE. Now they are in danger of BECOMING extinct. I think that rhinos should be bred in CAPTIVITY until they can live safely IN THE WILD, and people must stop buying PRODUCTS made from rhino horn!'
2-ODAM: 'Mae Lin, aged 23, wants to save the green-cheeked parrot.' (yosh ayol surati) Pufak: 'I first learnt about green-cheeked parrots at school. They are usually found in Mexico and are really good at copying people's voices. In the last twenty years, many have been smuggled across the BORDER to the USA, to be sold as pets. People VALUE them as pets because they are attractive and have AMUSING PERSONALITIES. Green-cheeked parrots are difficult to breed, so the species is slowly DYING OUT. In my opinion, people should only buy parrots which have been bred in captivity. Then the green-cheeked parrot could be left in the wild, where it would have a better CHANCE OF SURVIVAL.'
3-ODAM: 'Lee Barker, aged 34, works for the WWF and is worried about the alligator snapping turtle.' (yosh erkak surati) Pufak: 'Here at WWF, we're trying to save this species of turtle, which is the largest freshwater turtle in North America. In fact, it is facing extinction because it's killed for its meat. Snapping-turtle meat is often used in soups or sold in restaurants. Alligator snapping turtles only breed once a year. We believe that if people stopped buying these turtles as pets and stopped eating snapping-turtle soup, the turtles would have a chance to breed and survive.'

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development'.
5) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Qiya: 'freshwater, become, species, buy, nature, amusing, chance, endangered, face, rhino, protection'. 1 an ...... species 2 a ...... project 3 a ...... documentary 4 ...... horn 5 to ...... extinct 6 ...... personalities 7 a ...... of survival 8 to ...... extinction 9 a ...... turtle 10 this ...... of turtle 11 to ...... products.
6) 'Fill in the correct adverbs from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Qiya: 'usually, often, safely, once, slowly'. 1 they live ...... 2 they are ...... found 3 it is ...... dying out 4 it is ...... used 5 ...... a year.
7) 'Fill in the correct prepositions, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' 1 ...... danger of sth; 2 kill sth ...... sth; 3 ...... captivity; 4 ...... the wild; 5 made ...... rhino horn; 6 smuggled ...... the border; 7 ...... my opinion; 8 to be worried ...... sth.
• To'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the article again and make notes under the headings for each animal.' • where found • why facing extinction • suggested solutions. 'Use your notes to talk about the three endangered species.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '99'.

exercises.instructionEn: Animals in Danger. The World Wildlife Fund needs people to act now to help save the ten most endangered species in the world.
exercises.instructionUz: Xavf ostidagi hayvonlar. Jahon yovvoyi tabiat jamg'armasi dunyodagi eng xavf ostidagi o'nta turni saqlab qolishga yordam berish uchun odamlarning hozir harakat qilishiga muhtoj.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

JOHN HEWETT (26 yosh) maxsus
karkidon himoya loyihasi orqali
karkidonni 'asrab olmoqchi':
"Karkidonlar duch keladigan
xavflar haqida televizordagi tabiat
hujjatli filmi orqali bildim.
Karkidonlar sharqiy va janubiy
Afrikada yashaydi. Ularning vazni 3
dan 5 tonnagacha va soatiga 45 km
tezlikka yeta oladi. Bu noqonuniy
bo'lsa ham, ovchilar ularni juda
qimmatli shoxlari uchun o'ldiradi.
Endi ular yo'qolib ketish xavfi
ostida. Menimcha, karkidonlar
yovvoyi tabiatda xavfsiz yashay
olguncha asirlikda ko'paytirilishi
kerak, va odamlar karkidon shoxidan
yasalgan mahsulotlarni sotib olishni
to'xtatishi kerak!"

MAE LIN (23 yosh) yashil yuzli
to'tiqushni saqlamoqchi: "Yashil
yuzli to'tiqushlar haqida birinchi
marta maktabda bildim. Ular odatda
Meksikada uchraydi va odamlar
ovozini takrorlashga juda usta.
So'nggi 20 yilda ko'plari uy hayvoni
sifatida sotish uchun chegara orqali
AQShga kontrabanda qilingan. Odamlar
ularni uy hayvoni sifatida
qadrlaydi, chunki ular jozibali va
kulgili xarakterga ega. Yashil yuzli
to'tiqushlarni ko'paytirish qiyin,
shuning uchun tur asta-sekin yo'qolib
bormoqda. Mening fikrimcha, odamlar
faqat asirlikda ko'paytirilgan
to'tiqushlarni sotib olishi kerak.
Shunda yashil yuzli to'tiqush
yovvoyi tabiatda qoldirilishi mumkin
edi - u yerda omon qolish imkoni
yaxshiroq bo'lardi."

LEE BARKER (34 yosh) WWF da
ishlaydi va alligator toshbaqasi
haqida tashvishda: "Bu yerda, WWF
da, biz Shimoliy Amerikadagi eng
katta chuchuk suv toshbaqasi bo'lgan
bu turni saqlashga harakat qilyapmiz.
Aslida, u go'shti uchun o'ldirilgani
sababli yo'qolib ketish xavfiga duch
kelmoqda. Toshbaqa go'shti ko'pincha
sho'rvalarda ishlatiladi yoki
restoranlarda sotiladi. Alligator
toshbaqalari yiliga faqat bir marta
ko'payadi. Agar odamlar bu
toshbaqalarni uy hayvoni sifatida
sotib olishni va toshbaqa sho'rvasini
yeyishni to'xtatsa, toshbaqalar
ko'payish va omon qolish imkoniga
ega bo'lardi, deb ishonamiz."


QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  act = harakat qilmoq
  adopt = asrab olmoq (pul bilan
    homiylik)
  protection project = himoya
    loyihasi
  nature documentary = tabiat
    hujjatli filmi
  speed = tezlik
  illegal = noqonuniy
  valuable = qimmatli
  becoming = bo'lib bormoqda
  captivity = asirlik
  in the wild = yovvoyi tabiatda
  products = mahsulotlar
  border = chegara
  value = qadrlamoq
  amusing personalities = kulgili
    xarakterlar
  dying out = yo'qolib bormoqda
  chance of survival = omon qolish
    imkoni


⚠ 'WWF':

  = World Wildlife Fund - Jahon
  yovvoyi tabiat jamg'armasi.


⚠ 'TO WEIGH':

  = vazni bo'lmoq. /weɪ/.


⚠ 'ALTHOUGH':

  = ...ga qaramay, garchi.


⚠ 'TO SMUGGLE':

  = kontrabanda qilmoq.


⚠ 'TO BE GOOD AT + -ING':

  = ...ga usta bo'lmoq.


⚠ 'IN MY OPINION':

  = mening fikrimcha.


⚠ 'SHOULD BE BRED':

  = ko'paytirilishi kerak (modal
  majhul).

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.exampleEn: The rhino is an endangered species.

I watched a nature documentary about rhinos.
Hunters kill rhinos for rhino horn.
Rhinos are in danger of becoming extinct.
In the wild, the parrot would have a better chance of survival.
The alligator snapping turtle is facing extinction.
It is the largest freshwater turtle in North America.
WWF is trying to save this species of turtle.
People must stop buying products made from rhino horn.
modelAnswersUz: John himoya loyihasi orqali karkidonni asrab olmoqchi.
Men karkidonlar haqida tabiat hujjatli filmini ko'rdim.
Yovvoyi tabiatda to'tiqushning omon qolish imkoni yaxshiroq bo'lardi.
Alligator toshbaqasi yo'qolib ketish xavfiga duch kelmoqda.
U Shimoliy Amerikadagi eng katta chuchuk suv toshbaqasi.
WWF bu toshbaqa turini saqlashga harakat qilmoqda.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct adverbs from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri ravishlarni qo'ying, keyin to'ldirilgan iboralar bilan gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR (matndan):
  1 they live SAFELY
  2 they are USUALLY found
  3 it is SLOWLY dying out
  4 it is OFTEN used
  5 ONCE a year


⚠ RAVISh O'RNI:

  'be' dan KEYIN: 'are USUALLY
  found', 'is OFTEN used'.
  Fe'ldan KEYIN: 'live SAFELY'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct prepositions, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predloglarni qo'ying, keyin to'ldirilgan iboralar bilan gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR (matndan):
  1 IN danger of sth
  2 kill sth FOR sth
  3 IN captivity
  4 IN the wild
  5 made FROM rhino horn
  6 smuggled ACROSS the border
  7 IN my opinion
  8 to be worried ABOUT sth


⚠ 'MADE FROM' va 'MADE OF':

  made OF = material ko'rinib turadi
    (a table made of wood)
  made FROM = material o'zgargan
    (products made from horn)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article again and make notes under the headings for each animal: where found; why facing extinction; suggested solutions. Use your notes to talk about the three endangered species.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani yana o'qing va har hayvon uchun sarlavhalar ostida qaydlar yozing: qayerda uchraydi; nega yo'qolib ketish xavfida; taklif qilingan yechimlar. Qaydlaringizdan uchta xavf ostidagi tur haqida gapirish uchun foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  RHINO: eastern & southern Africa;
  hunted for horns; breed in
  captivity, stop buying horn
  products

  PARROT: Mexico; smuggled, sold as
  pets, difficult to breed; buy only
  captivity-bred parrots

  TURTLE: North America; killed for
  meat, breeds once a year; stop
  buying as pets, stop eating soup
exercises.exampleEn: Rhinos are found in eastern and southern Africa. They are facing extinction because hunters kill them for their horns. Rhinos should be bred in captivity and people should stop buying products made from rhino horn.
exercises.exampleUz: Karkidonlar sharqiy va janubiy Afrikada uchraydi. Ular yo'qolib ketish xavfida, chunki ovchilar ularni shoxi uchun o'ldiradi. Karkidonlar asirlikda ko'paytirilishi va odamlar karkidon shoxidan yasalgan mahsulotlarni sotib olishni to'xtatishi kerak.
modelAnswers: Green-cheeked parrots are found in Mexico. They are facing extinction because they are smuggled to the USA and sold as pets, and they are difficult to breed. People should only buy parrots which have been bred in captivity.

Alligator snapping turtles are found in North America. They are facing extinction because they are killed for their meat and they only breed once a year. People should stop buying them as pets and stop eating snapping-turtle soup.
modelAnswersUz: Yashil yuzli to'tiqushlar Meksikada uchraydi. Ular yo'qolib ketish xavfida, chunki AQShga kontrabanda qilinib, uy hayvoni sifatida sotiladi va ularni ko'paytirish qiyin. Odamlar faqat asirlikda ko'paytirilgan to'tiqushlarni sotib olishi kerak.

Alligator toshbaqalari Shimoliy Amerikada uchraydi. Ular yo'qolib ketish xavfida, chunki go'shti uchun o'ldiriladi va yiliga faqat bir marta ko'payadi. Odamlar ularni uy hayvoni sifatida sotib olishni va toshbaqa sho'rvasini yeyishni to'xtatishi kerak.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Xavf ostidagi hayvonlar haqida gapirish qoliplari.

patterns.formula: X is/are in danger of becoming extinct.
patterns.exampleEn: Rhinos are in danger of becoming extinct.

patterns.formula: X should be + V3 + in captivity.
patterns.exampleEn: Rhinos should be bred in captivity.

patterns.formula: In my opinion, people should + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: In my opinion, people should only buy parrots bred in captivity.
patterns.exampleUz: Mening fikrimcha, odamlar faqat asirlikda ko'paytirilgan to'tiqushlarni sotib olishi kerak.

patterns.formula: If people stopped + -ING, X would + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: If people stopped eating turtle soup, the turtles would survive.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar odamlar toshbaqa sho'rvasini yeyishni to'xtatsa, toshbaqalar omon qolardi.
